description: This file manages request header modifications within the WebKit browser component, including parsing JSON data for headers, setting headers for pages, and applying headers to URL requests.

methods.name: ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to extract header key-value pairs into a vector.

methods.name: RemoveRequestHeaders
methods.description: Removes stored headers for a given WebKit page.

methods.name: SetRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers for a specific WebKit page based on a JSON message.

methods.name: ApplyRequestHeaders
methods.description: Applies stored headers to a URL request for a WebKit page.
